features.name: Copilot Prompt Actions on Card and Document Pages
features.description: Extended support for copilot prompt actions to card page and document page types, in addition to existing list, list part, worksheet and standard dialog support. Allows actions to be rendered with greater prominence and connected to copilot branding.

features.name: Error and Message Display in Copilot Dialogs
features.description: Ability to display errors, warnings, and messages directly within copilot prompt dialogs without requiring separate popups. Supports classic dialog error, dialog message, and newer error info patterns.
caveats: Only the last message is shown if multiple are thrown
Line breaks are not supported in inline experience
If an error is thrown, subsequent messages will not be rendered

features.name: Column Resizing in Copilot Dialogs
features.description: Support to resize columns in copilot prompt dialogs as part of general support across Business Central. Applies per user and per page without requiring personalization permission.

features.name: Parallel Function Calling
features.description: Ability for AI models to return multiple tool calls in one response, optimizing round trips to the LLM. New AL interface available for functions to support this capability.

features.name: Telemetry for Copilot Features
features.description: Ability to get telemetry events from the AI module sent to Application Insights, allowing ISVs to track feature usage, feature uptake, and issues for their copilot features. Requires app insights connection and telemetry logger setup.
caveats: Requires application insights connection string in app.json
Requires telemetry logger setup in code

features.name: Managed AI Resources
features.description: Upcoming capability to enable managed AI resources so partners do not need to bring their own self-managed and dedicated AI resources. Will handle account management, usage tracking, cost management, and deployment scaling.

features.name: Suggest Project with Copilot Feature
features.description: Demo application showing a copilot action on the Project page that allows users to input a project description, generates a project proposal, and suggests tasks. Demonstrates error display in dialogs, column resizing, and function calling.

features.name: Prompt Guides
features.description: Custom prompt guides can be added to copilot extensions to guide users on what they can do with the copilot features, helping users discover functionality.

features.name: Copilot Progress Dialog Customization
features.description: Developers can customize the progress dialog message displayed while copilot is working, set user prompts, reset previous outputs, and implement retry logic with up to three attempts.

features.name: Manage Resource Authorization for Azure OpenAI
features.description: Partners can now use managed resource authorization with Azure OpenAI through the manage resource authorization code unit, eliminating the need for custom Azure subscriptions. This is currently in a preview program with selected partners and will open to all partners soon.
caveats: custom Azure subscription alternative still available

features.name: Copilot Capability Registration and Administration
features.description: Developers must register capabilities in the system which enables tracking and allows admins to control on a fine-grained level which copilot capabilities are active in their system.

features.name: Temperature and Max Tokens Configuration
features.description: Developers can fine-tune copilot parameters including max tokens and temperature to control output length and creativity level in different scenarios.

features.name: Chat Completion Endpoint with System and User Messages
features.description: The copilot chat completion endpoint accepts system messages defining the main task and user messages containing the actual user prompt, following a standard message format.

features.name: Tools and Function Calling
features.description: Developers can define tools (functions) that copilot can call, using a JSON object format to specify function definitions with parameters. This replaces the previous XML parsing approach and provides cleaner code.

features.name: Tool Invocation Preferences
features.description: Developers can control how tools are invoked through tool invoke preference settings including automatic invocation, manual invocation, and tool choice restrictions to limit which tools copilot can call.

features.name: AOI Function Interface Implementation
features.description: Developers must implement the AOI function interface which requires three mandated functions: get name, execute, and get prompt. The interface allows copilot to recognize and use custom functions.

features.name: Prompt Dialog Page Framework
features.description: A structured prompt dialog page with prompt area for user input and content area for copilot-generated output, supporting custom fields and repeaters for displaying results.
